text.description_html:
First Impressions 4 Inch Crystal Shower Door Knob Set With Flower Embellishment

The 4" Crystal Shower Door Knob Pair With Flower is made of imported 24% lead crystal with high quality brass mounting bases for long life. The extra large crystal knobs have lots of facets that produce a gleaming color array and the floral embellishment is the perfect finishing touch to soften the look. These sparkling crystal shower door knobs are easy to grab and compliment a bold designed bathroom. Available with bright polished chrome or satin nickel finish.

Also available: Single 4" Crystal Shower Door Knob

Available with bright polished chrome or satin nickel finish. The extra large crystal knobs have lots of facets that produce a gleaming color array.

Specifications for the First Impressions Pair of 4 Inch Crystal Shower Door Knobs With Flowers:

  • Knob Diameter: 4" (100 mm)
  • Mounting Base Diameter: 3/4"
  • Projection: 2-7/8"
  • Glass Hole Diameter: 3/8" - 1/2"
  • Material: 24% Lead Crystal / Solid Brass

Packaged with 2 crystal knobs and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting (knobs hook to each other) on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors, with either a 3/8" or 1/2" diameter hole in the glass.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Crystal Knobs - 1 knob for each side of the glass)
